filter: Review timestamp in the 48 hours ending at the live-board refresh. Accepted and non-final rejected rows only.
comparison_method: Reviewed in-window titles and instructions, screened descriptions for cap, fit, seat, roll, matched parts and retention, and compared the setup and score of candidate tasks.

matches.title: Tip a coin out of an uncapped inhaler's mouthpiece before putting its cap back on
matches.manipulation_and_scoring: Put a loose cap back on an inhaler after clearing a lodged coin. End checks include a cap depth within 1 mm, a light pull, no coin inside, and hands-off placement in a tray.
matches.comparison: Closest overlap in the physical operation and score. Both seat a loose cap on a hand-sized object and test retention. Recap three writing tools uses three supplied pairs, axial friction-fit bands, a keyed rectangular profile, and a two-second unsupported cap-down proof by the barrel for every pair.

matches.title: Move a speed pourer from the empty liquor bottle to the new one: hold the bottle, draw the pourer, push it home
matches.manipulation_and_scoring: Grip and pull a friction-fit pourer out of the old bottle, press it into a new bottle to within 2 mm of the lip, and test it with a 3.5 N pull while the bottles stand on the bar mat.
matches.comparison: Shares a coaxial friction fit, a shoulder reference, and a retention check. The insert goes inside a standing bottle and is transferred between bottles. The writing-tool caps go over free barrels, then hang by friction under their own weight.

matches.title: Load a full column of eight tips onto an 8-channel pipette, every tip sealed and level, without moving the tip box
matches.manipulation_and_scoring: Press eight tips from a rack onto a multichannel pipette. At the end, verify seating and level, with all tips clear of the box during a two-second lift by the pipette.
matches.comparison: Shares fitting multiple friction-retained parts and a timed clearance check. One press loads rack-supported tips onto one instrument. The writing-tool task requires separate cap and barrel grasps for each of the three free pairs.
